input: Log ten hours of volunteer work this quarter

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Whether the user already has a volunteer role lined up or needs to find one entirely changes the first steps of the plan.
Knowing whether this is solo volunteering or coordinated with a group/organisation affects scheduling and commitment flexibility.
Whether the volunteering is in-person at a fixed location or can be done remotely/flexibly affects how sessions are structured.
Knowing how much time per week the user can realistically dedicate determines how to spread the ten hours across the quarter.
The user says 'log' hours — knowing what system they need to record hours in (employer platform, spreadsheet, nonprofit portal) determines the tracking steps.
Understanding why the hours matter (employer CSR requirement, personal goal, grant requirement) defines what proof or sign-off is needed at the end.
Knowing what causes or types of activity the user cares about ensures the plan points them toward volunteer work they will actually follow through on.

gold.taskTitle: Log ten volunteer hours this quarter
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to complete and record ten hours of volunteer work before the current quarter ends.

questions.title: Do you already have a volunteer opportunity lined up?
questions.description: Determines whether the plan starts with finding an organisation or goes straight to scheduling hours.

questions.title: Is this for an employer, school, or personal requirement?
questions.description: Identifies why the hours are being logged, which defines what proof or sign-off is needed at completion.

questions.title: Which specific platform or system must the hours be logged in?
questions.description: Clarifies whether hours go into an employer portal, a nonprofit system, a spreadsheet, or another tool.

questions.title: How many hours per week can you realistically set aside?
questions.description: Determines how to pace the ten hours across the remaining weeks of the quarter without overcommitting.

questions.title: Will you volunteer in person or is remote volunteering an option?
questions.description: Affects what types of opportunities are viable and how sessions can be scheduled around the user's location.

questions.title: Are you volunteering solo or as part of a team or group?
questions.description: Determines whether coordination with others is needed, which adds scheduling dependencies to the plan.

questions.title: What causes or types of volunteer activity interest you most?
questions.description: Ensures the plan directs the user toward work they find meaningful, increasing the likelihood of follow-through.
